definitions.explanation: A small, round, hard piece of candy meant to be sucked rather than chewed. A traditional Japanese confection that comes in various flavors.

examples.english: To suck on a hard candy.

examples.japanese: ⟦おばあちゃん→おばあちゃん：10968_obaachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧{飴玉|あめだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: Grandma always gave me hard candies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喉|のど}→喉：00977_nodo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飴玉|あめだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|らく}になる→楽になる：26083_rakuninaru⟧。
examples.english: When your throat hurts, popping a hard candy in your mouth helps.

notes:
USAGE:
The word combines ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧ (candy) and ⟦{玉|たま}→玉：02221_tama⟧ (ball), describing the round shape. While ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧ can refer to any kind of candy or sweets in general, {飴玉|あめだま} specifically refers to the hard, round type.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飴玉|あめだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧なめる (to suck on a candy)
- {飴玉|あめだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しゃぶる→しゃぶる：05349_shaburu⟧ (to suck on a candy)
- {飴玉|あめだま}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}る→配る：03921_kubaru⟧ (to hand out candies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飴|あめ}→飴：00687_ame⟧: candy, sweets — broader term
- ⟦キャンディー→キャンディー：23081_kyandii⟧: candy — loanword, more modern feel
